pathway.title: Avient Corp — Full credit assessment
pathway.question: Should we own this issuer, in which instrument, and why?

runs.text: The business profile is Average: sizeable and diversified by customer and region, but without evidence of pricing power beyond the 2026 pass-through. Last-twelve-months sales were USD 3,416.2 million, no customer exceeded 3% of 2025 consolidated revenue and 61% of sales were outside the United States, which spreads demand risk across end markets and currencies. Gross margin fell to 31.2% in fiscal 2025 from 32.6% as costs and restructuring rose, and management says 2026 pricing actions offset input inflation, so pass-through has held so far but is untested in a downturn, and no peer set is supplied to benchmark it. Basis: 10-K_2025-12-31_avnt_avnt-20251231.htm.jsonl, page 9; 10-K_2025-12-31_avnt_avnt-20251231.htm.jsonl, page 36; 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 18; Business & governance (CP-1A); Financial foundation (CP-1); calculation F03

Earnings are recovering, but about two thirds of the 2026 EBITDA gain is charges leaving the window, so the recovery is smaller than the leverage ratios suggest. Last-twelve-months reported EBITDA of USD 521.4 million is USD 132.0 million above fiscal 2025, of which USD 86.3 million is the 2025 ERP impairment and hosting charges and USD 45.7 million, or 34.62%, is underlying. The margin of 15.26% compares with 14.64% for fiscal 2024 without a USD 34.7 million insurance gain and 14.59% for fiscal 2025 with the ERP charges added back, so the underlying margin rose by 0.62 percentage points to 0.67 percentage points over two years on mix and price. The issuer states no EBITDA, so these are derived figures, and environmental and restructuring costs remain inside them. Basis: Financial foundation (CP-1); 10-K_2025-12-31_avnt_avnt-20251231.htm.jsonl, page 36; calculation F03; calculation F04; calculation F05

Cash generation is a support, but debt reduction is currently running ahead of it. Free cash flow was USD 239.0 million over the last twelve months, 45.84% of EBITDA, with capital expenditures at 56.96% of depreciation and amortization, and USD 138.6 million remained after dividends of USD 100.4 million. In the first nine months of 2026, free cash flow after dividends of USD 37.9 million funded only part of the USD 100.0 million term-loan prepayment and cash fell USD 64.8 million. Low capital intensity gives room to cut spending in a downturn, although the 2026 estimate of about USD 140 million implies a heavier fourth quarter. Basis: Financial foundation (CP-1); 10-K_2025-12-31_avnt_avnt-20251231.htm.jsonl, page 39; 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 3; calculation F06; calculation F07; calculation F16; calculation F21; calculation F22

Liquidity is the main support and the runway to 2029 is clean. Liquidity of USD 932.4 million is cash of USD 445.7 million plus undrawn revolver availability of USD 486.7 million against only USD 1.0 million of principal due before 2029, and it covers the USD 471.1 million due in 2029 by 1.98x. About 83% of the cash is outside the United States and over half of liquidity is the revolver, which matures on 2030-06-12 and is subject to financial tests under certain circumstances whose levels are not supplied. If cash abroad were not usable, liquidity available in the United States would be about USD 562.5 million, still 1.19x the 2029 maturity. Basis: 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 22; 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 23; 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 10; 10-K_2025-12-31_avnt_avnt-20251231.htm.jsonl, page 24; calculation F08; calculation F09; calculation F20

Refinancing capacity is the weakest dimension: 99.95% of principal, USD 1,847.6 million, falls due in the three years from 2029 to 2031. That is 7.73 years of last-twelve-months free cash flow, or 13.33 years after dividends, so repayment cannot come from cash flow and depends on market access, with the revolver and the 2030 notes expiring in the same year and about a quarter of debt, 25.46%, on a floating rate. Claims outside debt add to the call, since cross-currency swap liabilities of USD 302.0 million bring debt plus swaps to USD 2,150.6 million. The issuer's own estimate puts the fair value of debt at 98.65% of principal, which shows no distress signal but is a model estimate, not a market quote. Basis: 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 9; 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 10; 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 12; 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 23; calculation F10; calculation F13; calculation F17; calculation F18; calculation F19

Interest cover is adequate but flattered by cross-currency swap receipts that will end. EBITDA covered cash interest paid, net of hedging, 3.99x in fiscal 2025 and last-twelve-months net interest expense 5.81x, but adding back the USD 36.1 million of swap receipts cuts fiscal 2025 cover to 2.91x. The swaps now mature between 2027 and 2029 on the 2025 schedule adjusted for the 2026 extensions, so interest cost rises by the receipts as they mature unless they are renewed, and the schedule after the extensions is not printed. Basis: 10-K_2025-12-31_avnt_avnt-20251231.htm.jsonl, page 69; 10-K_2025-12-31_avnt_avnt-20251231.htm.jsonl, page 84; 10-K_2025-12-31_avnt_avnt-20251231.htm.jsonl, page 85; 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 11; Financial foundation (CP-1); calculation F15

Financial policy is creditor-aligned in action but unproven under new management. The company has no sponsor or controlling holder named, prepaid USD 250.0 million of term loan in 2025 and 2026, bought back no shares and continued to raise the dividend per share each year, which supports a Low sponsor and governance risk level. The 2026 change of chief executive and chief financial officer is unexplained, the executed debt documents are not supplied, and a buyback authorisation remains open, so continuity of that policy rests on behaviour and not on documented limits. Basis: Business & governance (CP-1A); 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 10; 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 28; calculation F07; calculation F24

Legacy claims outside debt are a standing drag on cash flow and are not bounded. Environmental accruals were USD 142.9 million at 2026-09-30, the Calvert City accrual of USD 133.9 million is open-ended, and the IRS 2019 claim of USD 37.2 million carries no provision; with operating leases of USD 95.0 million and swap liabilities, quantified claims outside debt of USD 577.1 million equal 31.58% of carrying debt, though the dates and natures differ. The mechanism is a cash call that competes with debt service, and USD 28.1 million of environmental spending was due within a year at the end of 2025. Basis: 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 8; 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 16; 10-K_2025-12-31_avnt_avnt-20251231.htm.jsonl, page 41; Business & governance (CP-1A); calculation F14

The primary downside is a pricing squeeze, and it would reopen leverage rather than threaten liquidity before 2029. If input costs moved ahead of price and EBITDA fell back to its fiscal 2025 reported level, a fall of 25.32%, total debt would be 4.69x EBITDA and net debt 3.55x, free cash flow after dividends would shrink to about USD 6.6 million on the same inputs, and the debt would still need refinancing from 2029. Liquidity of USD 932.4 million and cuttable capital spending would carry the company through, but a weaker refinancing would then fall on a thinner cushion. Basis: Financial foundation (CP-1); 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 22; calculation F11; calculation F12; calculation F08

runs.text: Liquidity and a clean runway to 2029 are the strongest support. Liquidity of USD 932.4 million against USD 1.0 million of principal due before 2029 means no refinancing is forced for roughly two years, which lowers the near-term default risk that a three-year wall would otherwise carry. Basis: 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 22; 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 23; calculation F19

Cash generation is the second support. Free cash flow of USD 239.0 million over the last twelve months, 45.84% of EBITDA, comes from capital spending of only 3.18% of sales, and spending could be deferred in a downturn, which protects debt service. Basis: Financial foundation (CP-1); calculation F06; calculation F16

The demand base is spread across customers, regions and end markets. No customer exceeded 3% of 2025 revenue and 61% of sales were outside the United States, so a loss of any single account or market is unlikely to move earnings sharply, although contract tenor and renewal terms are not supplied. Basis: 10-K_2025-12-31_avnt_avnt-20251231.htm.jsonl, page 9; 10-K_2025-12-31_avnt_avnt-20251231.htm.jsonl, page 5; Business & governance (CP-1A)

Management actions favour creditors. Term-loan prepayments of USD 250.0 million over 2025 and 2026, no share repurchases and early refinancing of the 2025 notes and the 2026 revolver show cash going to debt before owners beyond the dividend, and reported net leverage fell from 3.63x to 2.65x in nine months. Basis: Business & governance (CP-1A); Financial foundation (CP-1); calculation F01; calculation F02; calculation F24

The concentrated maturity wall is the main weakness. Principal of USD 1,847.6 million, 99.95% of the total, falls due from 2029 to 2031, equal to 7.73 years of free cash flow, so repayment depends on refinancing in markets that are not visible in the filings. Basis: 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 23; calculation F10; calculation F19

Earnings quality is mixed. Most of the 2026 EBITDA gain is charges leaving the window, and the margin gains rely on pricing actions that offset inflation, so a lag in pass-through would reverse them before debt is reduced. Basis: Financial foundation (CP-1); 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 18; calculation F04; calculation F05

Legacy claims are unbounded. The Calvert City accrual is open-ended and the completion assumption has moved from 2030 to 2032, and the IRS claims carry no provision, so cash calls that compete with debt service could grow without a stated limit. Basis: 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 8; 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 16; Business & governance (CP-1A); calculation F14

Interest cost leans on swap receipts and a floating-rate term loan. Receipts of USD 36.1 million lowered fiscal 2025 cash interest, and 25.46% of principal floats, so cover of 3.99x would fall to 2.91x without the receipts and each 100 basis points on the term loan adds USD 4.71 million a year. Basis: 10-K_2025-12-31_avnt_avnt-20251231.htm.jsonl, page 69; 10-K_2025-12-31_avnt_avnt-20251231.htm.jsonl, page 84; 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 9; calculation F13; calculation F15

Control, covenant and leadership information is missing. Holder concentration, covenant levels and the reason for the 2026 officer changes are not supplied, so the Low sponsor and governance risk level and the use of the full revolver as liquidity rest on behaviour and company statements. Basis: Business & governance (CP-1A); Source readiness (CP-0)

runs.text: No acquisition, merger, sponsor transaction or new debt issue is stated for 2026 in the three quarterly reports, and nothing after the third-quarter report's signature on 2026-11-04 is supplied, so there is no pending transaction to underwrite and the position is as of that date. The cash flow statement for the first nine months of 2026 shows no borrowing proceeds, only dividends, term-loan repayments and other financing items. Basis: 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 3; 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 23; 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 29

The recent financing record is liability management, not new money. The 2031 senior unsecured notes of USD 650.0 million were issued on 2024-09-19 and, with cash on hand, redeemed the 2025 notes in full; the senior secured term loan was repriced on 2024-04-09 and on 2025-03-12; a revolver of up to USD 500.0 million maturing 2030-06-12 replaced the 2026 facility on 2025-06-12; and the term loan was prepaid by USD 150.0 million in 2025 and USD 100.0 million in 2026 from cash on hand. Principal outstanding at 2026-09-30 was USD 1,848.6 million, of which USD 470.7 million is the term loan due 2029, USD 725.0 million the 2030 notes and USD 650.0 million the 2031 notes. Basis: 10-K_2024-12-31_avnt_avnt-20241231.htm.jsonl, page 41; 10-K_2025-12-31_avnt_avnt-20251231.htm.jsonl, page 40; 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 9; 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 10; calculation C16

The last large transactions were in 2022. The sale of the Distribution business to an affiliate of H.I.G. Capital for USD 950.0 million cash closed on 2022-11-01, and business acquisitions net of cash acquired were USD 1,426.1 million in 2022, a purchase the 2024 annual report calls the APM Acquisition without tying the cash amount to it. Its purchase price, closing date, funding mix and earnings contribution are not stated in the supplied filings, so leverage at the time of the acquisition is not established. Basis: 10-K_2024-12-31_avnt_avnt-20241231.htm.jsonl, page 58; 10-K_2024-12-31_avnt_avnt-20241231.htm.jsonl, page 65; 10-K_2024-12-31_avnt_avnt-20241231.htm.jsonl, page 67; 10-K_2024-12-31_avnt_avnt-20241231.htm.jsonl, page 89

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Issuer: Avient Corp (avnt-1122976), a listed Ohio company reporting consolidated US GAAP statements in USD millions; as-of date 2026-11-18; pathway: credit snapshot. Scope: extract and normalise the audited annual and unaudited quarterly statements, derive last-twelve-months figures, and state debt, liquidity, leverage and coverage on the reported basis, with every gap named.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Avient's net leverage fell to 2.65x last-twelve-months reported EBITDA at 30 September 2026, from 3.63x at the end of 2025, but the gain is earnings recovery rather than debt reduction, so creditors depend on earnings holding. Net debt fell only USD 31.1 million in nine months, while last-twelve-months EBITDA rose USD 132.0 million to USD 521.4 million, of which USD 86.3 million is 2025 ERP charges leaving the window.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Basis: 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, pages 9–10; 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, pages 2–3; calculation C34; calculation C31; calculation C14; calculation C55; calculation C52

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Liquidity of USD 932.4 million exceeds the USD 471.1 million falling due in 2029, but cash interest cover was only 3.99x in fiscal 2025 and leans on cross-currency swap receipts, and Calvert City environmental costs of USD 19.1 million in the quarter show an obligation that is still growing.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Basis: 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 22; 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 23; 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 16; 10-K_2025-12-31_avnt_avnt-20251231.htm.jsonl, page 69; calculation C40

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Reported leverage moved in two steps. Total debt over reported EBITDA was 5.39x in fiscal 2023, 4.06x in fiscal 2024 and 4.94x in fiscal 2025, when USD 86.3 million of ERP impairment and hosting charges depressed EBITDA, and 3.50x at 30 September 2026; net debt over EBITDA followed the same path at 3.98x, 2.99x, 3.63x and 2.65x. The 2026 gain is mostly earnings: EBITDA for nine months was USD 434.7 million against USD 302.7 million, and USD 45.7 million of the USD 132.0 million increase is underlying once the 2025 charges are set aside. Debt moved little: total debt fell USD 95.9 million through USD 100.0 million of voluntary term loan prepayments, but cash fell USD 64.8 million, so net debt fell only USD 31.1 million.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Basis: 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, pages 2–3; 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 10; 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 14; 10-K_2025-12-31_avnt_avnt-20251231.htm.jsonl, pages 54–56; calculation C50; calculation C51; calculation C52; calculation C53; calculation C54; calculation C55; calculation C66

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Cash interest cover was 3.63x in fiscal 2023, 5.97x in fiscal 2024 and 3.99x in fiscal 2025, and no interim cash interest is printed, so cover for 2026 is not calculable. The measure uses interest paid net of hedging, and cross-currency swaps returned USD 36.1 million in fiscal 2025; adding that back to the USD 97.6 million of cash interest would put cover near 2.91x, an Analyst Judgement. On net interest expense, which also nets the swap receipts, last-twelve-months cover is 5.81x.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Basis: 10-K_2025-12-31_avnt_avnt-20251231.htm.jsonl, page 69; 10-K_2025-12-31_avnt_avnt-20251231.htm.jsonl, page 84; 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 2; calculation C59; calculation C60; calculation C22; calculation C14

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Cash conversion is steady and capital intensity low. Operating cash flow was USD 301.6 million in fiscal 2025 and USD 347.8 million over the last twelve months, which after capital expenditures converted 50.08% and 45.84% of EBITDA into free cash flow, with capital expenditures at 3.27% of sales in fiscal 2025. Receivables, inventories and payables absorbed USD 138.8 million in the first nine months of 2026, close to the USD 135.3 million of the prior-year period, so the seasonal build is normal; after USD 75.7 million of dividends, nine-month free cash flow left USD 37.9 million.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Basis: 10-K_2025-12-31_avnt_avnt-20251231.htm.jsonl, pages 55–56; 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 3; calculation C43; calculation C46; calculation C20; calculation C48; calculation C49; calculation C47

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Liquidity was USD 932.4 million at 30 September 2026, made of USD 445.7 million of cash and USD 486.7 million of revolver availability, against USD 1,000.8 million at the end of 2025; about 83% of the cash is outside the United States. Only USD 1.0 million of principal falls due before 2029, then USD 471.1 million in 2029, USD 725.5 million in 2030 and USD 651.0 million thereafter, so USD 1,847.6 million of principal sits in a three-year window from 2029 to 2031, and the undrawn revolver matures in June 2030 alongside the 2030 notes.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Basis: 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 22; 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 23; 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 10; calculation C40; calculation C39; calculation C62; calculation C61

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Several claims sit outside the USD 1,827.2 million of carrying-value debt. Cross-currency swap liabilities were USD 302.0 million at 30 September 2026, down from USD 380.9 million at the end of 2025, and the issuer has amended and extended the swaps rather than settling them in cash. Environmental accruals were USD 142.9 million, which the issuer says will probably be exceeded, with the Calvert City barrier wall now assumed complete in 2032. Operating lease obligations were USD 95.0 million undiscounted at the end of 2025, and the IRS 2019 matter claims USD 37.2 million of tax, interest and penalty with no provision, plus a 2022 matter with no amount printed. Pension plans were net overfunded by USD 4.7 million.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Basis: 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, pages 11–12; 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 8; 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 16; 10-K_2025-12-31_avnt_avnt-20251231.htm.jsonl, page 41; 10-K_2025-12-31_avnt_avnt-20251231.htm.jsonl, page 71; calculation C63; calculation C64; calculation C65; calculation C67

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: The figures rest on EBITDA that this analysis derives, because the issuer states none, and on carrying-value debt of USD 1,827.2 million against principal of USD 1,848.6 million. No supplier finance, factoring or customer-funded float was found, and no event after the balance-sheet date is stated; the one flagged subsequent event is the 2025 decision to stop ERP development, which the FY2024 annual report dated after its own balance sheet and which is kept out of fiscal 2024.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Basis: 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 9; 10-K_2024-12-31_avnt_avnt-20241231.htm.jsonl, page 35; 10-K_2024-12-31_avnt_avnt-20241231.htm.jsonl, page 90; calculation C36; calculation C37

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: The strongest case that leverage is better than it looks is that fiscal 2025 EBITDA was depressed by USD 86.3 million of ERP charges: on a normalised basis fiscal 2025 total debt over EBITDA would have been 4.04x and net debt 2.97x, so underlying leverage was already improving before 2026. The strongest case that it is worse is that reported EBITDA still carries environmental and restructuring costs, that cover and interest cost lean on swap receipts, and that the swaps mature in 2028 and 2029 and have been rolled rather than settled. The view would weaken if rolling EBITDA slipped back toward the fiscal 2025 level of USD 389.4 million, if the Calvert City accrual rose again, or if the swaps were settled in cash; it would strengthen if the 2029 term loan were refinanced well ahead of maturity and interim cash interest were disclosed.

fields.value: Basis: 10-K_2025-12-31_avnt_avnt-20251231.htm.jsonl, page 36; 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, pages 11–12; 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 16; calculation C56; calculation C57; calculation C58; calculation C63

fields.value: The ratios divide carrying-value debt by reported EBITDA built from operating income plus depreciation and amortization, so the fiscal 2025 ratio carries about USD 86.3 million of ERP impairment and hosting charges that the later last-twelve-months windows no longer include.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Cover is stated on interest paid net of swap receipts and is available for fiscal years only.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Undrawn amounts are the issuer's printed revolver availability, and the 2026 reports do not itemize the letters of credit that reduce it from the commitment.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: The ladder is principal at 2026-09-30, not carrying value, and the last row is the filing's thereafter bucket.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: The Adjusted EBITDA column holds reported EBITDA because the issuer states no adjusted measure, and fiscal 2025 includes the ERP charges.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: The debt stack is not supplied because ranking and guarantor scope are not stated.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: The subsequent events the sources flag are dated: the FY2024 annual report describes the decision to stop S/4HANA development, taken in the first quarter of 2025, as a subsequent event to its December 31, 2024 balance sheet, and the 2026-09-30 quarterly report discloses a draft IRS notice received in September 2026. Neither is blended into the period figures above.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Every figure below is arithmetic on printed figures, in USD millions unless stated; lines marked Analyst Judgement are this analysis's own adjustments and feed no ratio in the register.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: - Cash interest paid is not printed in any quarterly report, so EBITDA over cash interest is not calculable for 2026-03-31, 2026-06-30 and 2026-09-30, and interim cover can only be shown on net interest expense as a proxy. Severity: Medium. Action: obtain interest paid for the interim periods or keep cover to fiscal years.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: - Cash taxes paid are printed for fiscal years only, so interim cash taxes and free cash flow after tax for 2026 are not established. Severity: Low. Action: use the annual figures with their period label.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: - The issuer states no adjusted EBITDA, no add-backs and no management bridge, so the adjusted EBITDA row, the adjusted ratios and the EBITDA bridge are not supplied and reported EBITDA is derived by this analysis. Severity: Medium. Action: obtain any management bridge, otherwise keep house adjustments labelled as Analyst Judgement.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: - Financial test levels and definitions are not printed and the credit agreement is not supplied, so covenant headroom is not calculable at any date. The filings say only that the revolver requires compliance with financial tests under certain circumstances and that the company complied with all covenants. Severity: High. Action: obtain the executed credit agreement and compliance certificates.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: - Ranking, guarantors and collateral are not stated for the revolver, the term loan, the 2030 notes or the other debt, and the FY2024 annual report calls only the 2031 notes senior unsecured obligations, so the debt stack is not drawn and debt by seniority is not established. Severity: High. Action: obtain the executed agreements and indentures.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: - Letters-of-credit usage is not printed in the 2026 reports, so net availability rests on the issuer's printed availability of USD 486.7 million; the implied difference from the commitment is USD 13.3 million but is not stated as letters of credit. Severity: Medium. Action: obtain the current letters-of-credit schedule.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: - Revolver availability at 2023-12-31 is not printed, so liquidity for fiscal 2023 is not established, and fiscal 2024 availability reflects the earlier revolver that was replaced in June 2025. Severity: Low. Action: none needed for the current position.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: - The statements print a dash for Other income (expense), net in the third quarter of 2025 and for Proceeds from long-term borrowings in fiscal 2023 and fiscal 2025; these are held as not supplied rather than zero. Severity: Low. Action: none.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: - Payments on long-term borrowings and Proceeds from long-term borrowings are not printed in the first-quarter statements, and the interim reports print no proceeds line, so those cells are not supplied. Severity: Low. Action: none; the six- and nine-month statements carry the payments.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: - The filings give maturities in aggregate only, so the term loan's scheduled amortisation, the exact maturity dates of the term loan and 2030 notes, the revolver margin and the composition of other debt are not stated; the notes are shown with no scheduled amortisation because the ladder shows only USD 1.0 million of principal due before 2029 across all debt. Severity: Low. Action: obtain the credit agreement and the indentures.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: - The swap maturity schedule after the June and July 2026 extensions is not printed, so which swaps make up the current liability of USD 97.2 million is not established. Severity: Medium. Action: obtain the current derivative schedule.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: - The IRS draft notice of proposed adjustment on the 2022 capital loss, received in September 2026, has no amount and no reserve, so the size of that claim is not established. Severity: Medium. Action: monitor for the notice amount.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: - The Calvert City accrual is open-ended: the issuer says additional costs above the accrual are probable and cannot be estimated, and the barrier wall completion date moved to 2032 in the third quarter, so the total environmental claim is not bounded. fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Financial policy shown by actions is creditor-aligned. The company prepaid USD 150.0 million of the senior secured term loan in 2025 and USD 100.0 million in 2026 from cash on hand, without penalty, so total debt principal fell USD 100.3 million in nine months to USD 1,848.6 million and the senior secured term loan shrank to USD 470.7 million. It also replaced the 2025 notes with 2031 senior unsecured notes in 2024 and a new USD 500.0 million revolver running to 2030 in 2025, so refinancing has been done early and without new money. The mechanism is lower interest cost and a smaller secured claim ranking ahead of the unsecured notes on collateral value, although collateral and guarantor terms are not supplied.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: The business is diversified by customer and region but exposed to input costs and to the pace of pricing. No customer exceeded 3% of 2025 consolidated revenue, and fiscal 2025 sales of USD 3,260.2 million split 62.39% Color, Additives and Inks and 37.77% Specialty Engineered Materials, with 40.16% from the United States and Canada, 36.06% from EMEA, 18.19% from Asia and 5.59% from Latin America. The 2026 recovery is partly price: nine-month sales rose 6.2% with organic growth of 4.2%, operating margins widened to 16.44% in Color, Additives and Inks and 14.91% in Specialty Engineered Materials from 15.48% and 13.31%, and management says pricing actions offset input inflation, while its own risk factor warns that raw-material and energy costs may not move with selling prices. If pass-through lags, the margin gain could reverse before debt is reduced.

fields.value: Legacy claims outside debt are the main exposure that cannot be bounded, and they are growing rather than settling. The Calvert City accrual was USD 133.9 million at 2026-09-30 within total environmental accruals of USD 142.9 million, the filing says further costs above the accrual are probable and cannot be estimated, and charges were USD 56.8 million in 2023, USD 19.8 million in 2024, USD 21.3 million in 2025 and USD 27.7 million in the first nine months of 2026, with the completion assumption moving to 2032. The obligation traces to a 1993 indemnity given by Avient's predecessor, not to an owner decision, and USD 28.1 million of the USD 141.2 million obligation at the end of 2025 was due within a year, so the cash call competes with debt service; two unreserved IRS matters add a 2019 claim of USD 37.2 million and a second claim of unstated size.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: The strongest evidence against a Low-risk reading is behavioural uncertainty, not a documented adverse act. Both senior officers named in the 2026 filings differ from the annual report with no explanation, a buyback authorisation equal to 5.40% of shares outstanding remains open and share repurchases are listed among the expected uses of cash for the rest of 2026, dividends exceeded fiscal 2025 earnings, and the unreserved tax claims and the open-ended Calvert City accrual could absorb the cash that now goes to term-loan prepayment. The view would worsen to Medium if new management announced debt-funded repurchases or an acquisition, if the proxy statement showed a large holder pressing for change, or if the executed debt documents showed wide restricted-payment capacity. It would firm up if the proxy statement showed dispersed holdings and an independent board, if the leadership changes were explained as planned succession, and if prepayments continued.

fields.value: The recent financing record is liability management, not new money. The 2031 senior unsecured notes of USD 650.0 million were issued on 2024-09-19 and, with cash on hand, redeemed the 2025 notes in full; the senior secured term loan was repriced on 2024-04-09 and on 2025-03-12; a revolver of up to USD 500.0 million maturing 2030-06-12 replaced the 2026 facility on 2025-06-12; and the term loan was prepaid by USD 150.0 million in 2025 and USD 100.0 million in 2026 from cash on hand. Principal outstanding at 2026-09-30 was USD 1,848.6 million, of which USD 470.7 million is the term loan due 2029, USD 725.0 million the 2030 notes and USD 650.0 million the 2031 notes.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: The risk level is driven by the absence of a named sponsor and by documented creditor-aligned behaviour, because cash has gone to term-loan prepayment and not to buybacks, which implies lower leverage and refinancing risk. Countervailing evidence is the unexplained change of the chief executive and chief financial officer in 2026, a dividend above fiscal 2025 earnings, and an open-ended environmental claim. Further analysis requires the proxy statement, the executed debt documents and an explanation of the officer changes.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Issuer: Avient Corp (avnt-1122976), a listed Ohio company reporting consolidated US GAAP statements in USD millions; as-of date 2026-11-18; pathway: credit snapshot. Scope: the overall fundamental credit profile, its main support and constraints, the primary downside path and the signals to monitor, from the five supplied filings and the three earlier module outputs.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: The earlier modules are used as supplied; this module recomputes every ratio it quotes from printed figures and marks where it adds judgement.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Avient's credit profile is adequate and improving, supported by USD 932.4 million of liquidity and no material maturity before 2029, but a concentrated 2029 to 2031 wall and open-ended legacy costs make creditors dependent on earnings holding.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Basis: 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 22; 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 23; Financial foundation (CP-1); calculation F08; calculation F19

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Reported net leverage of 2.65x last-twelve-months EBITDA is down from 3.63x at the end of 2025, but only USD 45.7 million of the USD 132.0 million EBITDA gain is underlying, so the profile is Average, not Strong. The primary downside is a pricing squeeze that returns EBITDA toward its 2025 level while dividends of USD 100.4 million, restructuring and Calvert City cash calls continue.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Basis: Financial foundation (CP-1); Business & governance (CP-1A); calculation F01; calculation F02; calculation F05; calculation F07; calculation F11

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: The business profile is Average: sizeable and diversified by customer and region, but without evidence of pricing power beyond the 2026 pass-through. Last-twelve-months sales were USD 3,416.2 million, no customer exceeded 3% of 2025 consolidated revenue and 61% of sales were outside the United States, which spreads demand risk across end markets and currencies. Gross margin fell to 31.2% in fiscal 2025 from 32.6% as costs and restructuring rose, and management says 2026 pricing actions offset input inflation, so pass-through has held so far but is untested in a downturn, and no peer set is supplied to benchmark it.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Basis: 10-K_2025-12-31_avnt_avnt-20251231.htm.jsonl, page 9; 10-K_2025-12-31_avnt_avnt-20251231.htm.jsonl, page 36; 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 18; Business & governance (CP-1A); Financial foundation (CP-1); calculation F03

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Earnings are recovering, but about two thirds of the 2026 EBITDA gain is charges leaving the window, so the recovery is smaller than the leverage ratios suggest. Last-twelve-months reported EBITDA of USD 521.4 million is USD 132.0 million above fiscal 2025, of which USD 86.3 million is the 2025 ERP impairment and hosting charges and USD 45.7 million, or 34.62%, is underlying. The margin of 15.26% compares with 14.64% for fiscal 2024 without a USD 34.7 million insurance gain and 14.59% for fiscal 2025 with the ERP charges added back, so the underlying margin rose by 0.62 percentage points to 0.67 percentage points over two years on mix and price. The issuer states no EBITDA, so these are derived figures, and environmental and restructuring costs remain inside them.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Basis: Financial foundation (CP-1); 10-K_2025-12-31_avnt_avnt-20251231.htm.jsonl, page 36; calculation F03; calculation F04; calculation F05

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Cash generation is a support, but debt reduction is currently running ahead of it. Free cash flow was USD 239.0 million over the last twelve months, 45.84% of EBITDA, with capital expenditures at 56.96% of depreciation and amortization, and USD 138.6 million remained after dividends of USD 100.4 million. In the first nine months of 2026, free cash flow after dividends of USD 37.9 million funded only part of the USD 100.0 million term-loan prepayment and cash fell USD 64.8 million. Low capital intensity gives room to cut spending in a downturn, although the 2026 estimate of about USD 140 million implies a heavier fourth quarter.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Basis: Financial foundation (CP-1); 10-K_2025-12-31_avnt_avnt-20251231.htm.jsonl, page 39; 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 3; calculation F06; calculation F07; calculation F16; calculation F21; calculation F22

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Liquidity is the main support and the runway to 2029 is clean. Liquidity of USD 932.4 million is cash of USD 445.7 million plus undrawn revolver availability of USD 486.7 million against only USD 1.0 million of principal due before 2029, and it covers the USD 471.1 million due in 2029 by 1.98x. About 83% of the cash is outside the United States and over half of liquidity is the revolver, which matures on 2030-06-12 and is subject to financial tests under certain circumstances whose levels are not supplied. If cash abroad were not usable, liquidity available in the United States would be about USD 562.5 million, still 1.19x the 2029 maturity.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Basis: 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 22; 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 23; 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 10; 10-K_2025-12-31_avnt_avnt-20251231.htm.jsonl, page 24; calculation F08; calculation F09; calculation F20

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Refinancing capacity is the weakest dimension: 99.95% of principal, USD 1,847.6 million, falls due in the three years from 2029 to 2031. That is 7.73 years of last-twelve-months free cash flow, or 13.33 years after dividends, so repayment cannot come from cash flow and depends on market access, with the revolver and the 2030 notes expiring in the same year and about a quarter of debt, 25.46%, on a floating rate. Claims outside debt add to the call, since cross-currency swap liabilities of USD 302.0 million bring debt plus swaps to USD 2,150.6 million. The issuer's own estimate puts the fair value of debt at 98.65% of principal, which shows no distress signal but is a model estimate, not a market quote.

fields.value: Basis: 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 9; 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 10; 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 12; 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 23; calculation F10; calculation F13; calculation F17; calculation F18; calculation F19

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Interest cover is adequate but flattered by cross-currency swap receipts that will end. EBITDA covered cash interest paid, net of hedging, 3.99x in fiscal 2025 and last-twelve-months net interest expense 5.81x, but adding back the USD 36.1 million of swap receipts cuts fiscal 2025 cover to 2.91x. The swaps now mature between 2027 and 2029 on the 2025 schedule adjusted for the 2026 extensions, so interest cost rises by the receipts as they mature unless they are renewed, and the schedule after the extensions is not printed.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Basis: 10-K_2025-12-31_avnt_avnt-20251231.htm.jsonl, page 69; 10-K_2025-12-31_avnt_avnt-20251231.htm.jsonl, page 84; 10-K_2025-12-31_avnt_avnt-20251231.htm.jsonl, page 85; 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 11; Financial foundation (CP-1); calculation F15

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Financial policy is creditor-aligned in action but unproven under new management. The company has no sponsor or controlling holder named, prepaid USD 250.0 million of term loan in 2025 and 2026, bought back no shares and continued to raise the dividend per share each year, which supports a Low sponsor and governance risk level. The 2026 change of chief executive and chief financial officer is unexplained, the executed debt documents are not supplied, and a buyback authorisation remains open, so continuity of that policy rests on behaviour and not on documented limits.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Basis: Business & governance (CP-1A); 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 10; 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 28; calculation F07; calculation F24

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Legacy claims outside debt are a standing drag on cash flow and are not bounded. Environmental accruals were USD 142.9 million at 2026-09-30, the Calvert City accrual of USD 133.9 million is open-ended, and the IRS 2019 claim of USD 37.2 million carries no provision; with operating leases of USD 95.0 million and swap liabilities, quantified claims outside debt of USD 577.1 million equal 31.58% of carrying debt, though the dates and natures differ. The mechanism is a cash call that competes with debt service, and USD 28.1 million of environmental spending was due within a year at the end of 2025.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Basis: 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 8; 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 16; 10-K_2025-12-31_avnt_avnt-20251231.htm.jsonl, page 41; Business & governance (CP-1A); calculation F14

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: The primary downside is a pricing squeeze, and it would reopen leverage rather than threaten liquidity before 2029. If input costs moved ahead of price and EBITDA fell back to its fiscal 2025 reported level, a fall of 25.32%, total debt would be 4.69x EBITDA and net debt 3.55x, free cash flow after dividends would shrink to about USD 6.6 million on the same inputs, and the debt would still need refinancing from 2029. Liquidity of USD 932.4 million and cuttable capital spending would carry the company through, but a weaker refinancing would then fall on a thinner cushion.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Basis: Financial foundation (CP-1); 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 22; calculation F11; calculation F12; calculation F08

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: The strongest evidence against an adequate and improving profile is how recently it was weaker. Total debt was 4.94x EBITDA and net debt 3.63x at the end of 2025, operating income fell 38.2% in that year on flat sales, and the 2026 recovery rests partly on pricing that is not yet tested by a downturn, while 99.95% of principal comes due within three years of 2029. The strongest evidence for a better view is that net debt is falling, liquidity covers the 2029 maturity 1.98x and free cash flow of USD 239.0 million is 45.84% of EBITDA. The view would weaken if the last-twelve-months EBITDA margin fell below the 14.59% of normalised fiscal 2025, if the Calvert City accrual rose again, if the swaps were settled in cash, or if new management announced debt-funded buybacks or an acquisition. It would strengthen if the 2029 term loan were refinanced well before maturity, if cash interest were disclosed for interim periods, or if the debt documents showed covenant headroom and priority terms.

fields.value: Basis: Financial foundation (CP-1); 10-K_2025-12-31_avnt_avnt-20251231.htm.jsonl, page 35; 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 23; calculation F02; calculation F03; calculation F06; calculation F08; calculation F19; calculation F23

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: - No peer set, rating or market price is supplied, so the Average assessment of the business and the reading of liquidity as the main support are judged against the issuer's own history, and relative strength among leveraged issuers is not established.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: - EBITDA is derived as operating income plus depreciation and amortization because the issuer states none, so the leverage and cover ratios are reported-basis figures and the normalised figures add back the ERP charges as an analyst adjustment that could be challenged.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: - Revolver covenant levels, priority and guarantee terms are not supplied, so the use of the full revolver availability as liquidity and the order in which creditors would be repaid are not tested, and the liquidity conclusion could be overstated if tests restrict drawing.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: - The swap maturity schedule after the 2026 extensions and the settlement terms are not printed, so the size and date of any cash call from the USD 302.0 million liability are not established, and the refinancing conclusion treats it as a possible additional claim.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: - Interim cash interest, cash taxes and management projections are not supplied, so 2026 cash conversion is read from operating cash flow as printed and the outlook is qualitative, which limits the downside scenario to arithmetic on reported figures.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Liquidity and a clean runway to 2029 are the strongest support. Liquidity of USD 932.4 million against USD 1.0 million of principal due before 2029 means no refinancing is forced for roughly two years, which lowers the near-term default risk that a three-year wall would otherwise carry.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Cash generation is the second support. Free cash flow of USD 239.0 million over the last twelve months, 45.84% of EBITDA, comes from capital spending of only 3.18% of sales, and spending could be deferred in a downturn, which protects debt service.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Basis: Financial foundation (CP-1); calculation F06; calculation F16

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: The demand base is spread across customers, regions and end markets. No customer exceeded 3% of 2025 revenue and 61% of sales were outside the United States, so a loss of any single account or market is unlikely to move earnings sharply, although contract tenor and renewal terms are not supplied.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Management actions favour creditors. Term-loan prepayments of USD 250.0 million over 2025 and 2026, no share repurchases and early refinancing of the 2025 notes and the 2026 revolver show cash going to debt before owners beyond the dividend, and reported net leverage fell from 3.63x to 2.65x in nine months.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Basis: Business & governance (CP-1A); Financial foundation (CP-1); calculation F01; calculation F02; calculation F24

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: The concentrated maturity wall is the main weakness. Principal of USD 1,847.6 million, 99.95% of the total, falls due from 2029 to 2031, equal to 7.73 years of free cash flow, so repayment depends on refinancing in markets that are not visible in the filings.

fields.value: Interest cost leans on swap receipts and a floating-rate term loan. Receipts of USD 36.1 million lowered fiscal 2025 cash interest, and 25.46% of principal floats, so cover of 3.99x would fall to 2.91x without the receipts and each 100 basis points on the term loan adds USD 4.71 million a year.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Control, covenant and leadership information is missing. Holder concentration, covenant levels and the reason for the 2026 officer changes are not supplied, so the Low sponsor and governance risk level and the use of the full revolver as liquidity rest on behaviour and company statements.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Avient formulates specialty polymer materials from purchased resins and additives and sells them through two segments, Color, Additives and Inks and Specialty Engineered Materials, which together produced sales of USD 3,260.2 million in fiscal 2025. Revenue is order-driven with short manufacturing lead times, contract tenor and renewal rates are not supplied, and no customer exceeded 3% of revenue, so visibility comes from breadth rather than from a stated backlog, with defense tenders the main lumpy exception. Fiscal 2025 sales were flat and growth returned in 2026, with third-quarter sales up 10.5% on packaging, building and construction, industrial, consumer and energy demand and pricing actions, and nine-month sales up 6.2% of which 4.2% was organic. For creditors this means cash flow is steady but follows industrial and consumer demand and input prices, so debt service capacity depends on keeping price ahead of cost.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Basis: 10-K_2025-12-31_avnt_avnt-20251231.htm.jsonl, page 5; 10-K_2025-12-31_avnt_avnt-20251231.htm.jsonl, page 9; 10-K_2025-12-31_avnt_avnt-20251231.htm.jsonl, page 19; 10-K_2025-12-31_avnt_avnt-20251231.htm.jsonl, page 35; 10-K_2025-12-31_avnt_avnt-20251231.htm.jsonl, page 36; 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 17; 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 18; Business & governance (CP-1A)

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Cost of sales was 68.85% of fiscal 2025 sales and selling and administrative expense 24.91%, so most cost is variable with resin, pigment and energy prices, which the company warns may not move with selling prices. That gives some flexibility to cut cost with volume but leaves margin exposed to a price lag, and the operating margin of 6.24% in fiscal 2025 against 10.16% in fiscal 2024 shows how charges and cost swings move it. Capital spending of 3.18% of last-twelve-months sales and the cost savings the company cites from productivity and restructuring actions support conversion of EBITDA into free cash flow, 50.08% in fiscal 2025 and 45.84% over the last twelve months, while working capital absorbed USD 138.8 million in nine months of 2026 against USD 135.3 million a year earlier, a normal seasonal build. Cash interest, cash taxes and restructuring cash all sit below EBITDA, so the conversion is a better guide to debt service capacity than the EBITDA ratios.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Avient is a public company with no sponsor, parent or controlling holder named in the filings, and its consolidated perimeter is the only group structure supplied; borrower and guarantor perimeters and the priority of the notes against the secured term loan and revolver are not established. Financial policy shown by action is conservative: debt was prepaid from cash, no shares were repurchased, the dividend rose each year and no acquisition has been paid for since 2022, so leverage tolerance appears to have fallen as net leverage moved from 3.63x to 2.65x. The unexplained change of chief executive and chief financial officer in 2026, and a buyback authorisation that remains open, are the points that could change that policy.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Basis: Business & governance (CP-1A); Financial foundation (CP-1); calculation F01; calculation F02

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Competition is global and local: the company competes with global companies and local niche producers on performance, innovation, service, quality, delivery and price, and with polymer and non-polymer alternatives, so rivalry limits price increases beyond cost pass-through. Buyer power is dispersed because no customer exceeds 3% of revenue, while supplier power sits with large chemical producers, whose resin and additive prices Avient cannot control and, for some strategic materials, cannot easily replace. Trade policy and currency are the material external factors: the annual report names tariffs and retaliatory measures as risks to demand and results, 61% of sales are outside the United States, and the euro net investment is hedged with swaps whose liability is USD 302.0 million, so a stronger dollar or new tariffs would pressure translated earnings, while plastics and environmental regulation add compliance cost. In credit terms the strengths are liquidity, cash generation and diversification, the weaknesses are the maturity wall, legacy claims and swap-supported interest cost, the opportunities are growth in defense, healthcare, electronics and infrastructure applications where growth-vector sales are outpacing the rest of the company, and the threats are input-cost inflation without pricing, tariffs and a weaker refinancing market in 2029 to 2031.

fields.value: Basis: 10-K_2025-12-31_avnt_avnt-20251231.htm.jsonl, page 5; 10-K_2025-12-31_avnt_avnt-20251231.htm.jsonl, page 7; 10-K_2025-12-31_avnt_avnt-20251231.htm.jsonl, page 8; 10-K_2025-12-31_avnt_avnt-20251231.htm.jsonl, page 15; 10-K_2025-12-31_avnt_avnt-20251231.htm.jsonl, page 17; 10-K_2025-12-31_avnt_avnt-20251231.htm.jsonl, page 19; 10-K_2025-12-31_avnt_avnt-20251231.htm.jsonl, page 23; 10-K_2025-12-31_avnt_avnt-20251231.htm.jsonl, page 35; 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 12; calculation F18

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Over the next 12 to 24 months the supports are pricing and mix, growth in defense, packaging and infrastructure demand, restructuring savings and lower interest from prepayments, while the pressures are input-cost inflation, tariffs, the Calvert City cost and timeline, tax claims and a fourth-quarter capital spending step-up toward the 2026 estimate of about USD 140 million. No guidance or forecast is supplied, so the outlook is qualitative: leverage should keep falling if the margin holds, but each of the pressures draws on cash that now goes to prepayment. Over three to five years the outlook is dominated by refinancing the term loan in 2029, the notes and revolver in 2030 and the 2031 notes, with swap maturities between 2027 and 2029 adding a possible cash call.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Basis: 10-K_2025-12-31_avnt_avnt-20251231.htm.jsonl, page 39; 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 18; 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 19; 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 21; 10-Q_2026-09-30_avnt_avnt-20260930.htm.jsonl, page 23; calculation F22

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: The realistic downside starts with raw-material, energy and freight costs rising faster than selling prices in packaging, consumer and industrial markets, which the annual report names as a risk. The first operational break is gross margin, because cost of sales is most of the cost base and pass-through has only been shown in an upswing. If EBITDA fell back to its fiscal 2025 reported level, a fall of USD 132.0 million, total debt would be 4.69x EBITDA and net debt 3.55x, and free cash flow after dividends would be about USD 6.6 million before tax relief and working-capital release, so debt reduction would stop and the prepayment would have to come from cash. Management levers are the dividend of USD 100.4 million a year, capital spending that runs at about 57% of depreciation and amortization, restructuring and the unused buyback authority, and liquidity of USD 932.4 million would absorb the shortfall, so liquidity distress before 2029 is not indicated. The consequence is on refinancing: the USD 470.7 million term loan due in 2029 becomes current in 2028 and would be refinanced at 3.55x to 4.69x leverage and with Calvert City costs still open. The observable triggers are a falling EBITDA margin, a lag between price and cost, a rising environmental accrual and a swap settlement.

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Basis: 10-K_2025-12-31_avnt_avnt-20251231.htm.jsonl, page 19; 10-K_2025-12-31_avnt_avnt-20251231.htm.jsonl, page 41; Financial foundation (CP-1); calculation F11; calculation F12; calculation F07; calculation F08; calculation F16

fields.name: Quote
fields.value: Overall, Avient presents an adequate business profile supported by diversified customers, steady free cash flow and USD 932.4 million of liquidity, but credit quality is constrained by a USD 1,847.6 million maturity wall from 2029 to 2031 and by legacy claims that are not bounded. Cash-flow durability appears adequate because free cash flow of USD 239.0 million covers dividends of USD 100.4 million and low capital spending, although part of the 2026 earnings gain is charges leaving the window. Refinancing capacity is likely to depend on market access in 2028 and 2029, the margin holding, the Calvert City accrual stabilising and the treatment of the swap liabilities. The primary downside path is a pricing squeeze that returns EBITDA toward its 2025 level and leaves less cushion for refinancing. Further analysis would require the executed debt documents, covenant levels, the swap schedule, interim cash interest, a peer set and the proxy statement. Fundamental credit assessment completed. Top risk: refinancing of the 2029 to 2031 maturity wall.
